thresholdHint: Set the maximum amount permitted for automatic sending.
emailsHint: Manage the email addresses allowed for agent correspondence.
originsHint: Limit the sites the agent’s browser can access.
flagsHint: Enable available features, grouped by priority.

invalid.threshold: Enter a non-negative amount with up to two decimal places (decimal point).
invalid.origins: Enter an HTTP(S) origin without a path, for example https://example.test.

agentHint: The pause/resume button is always available in the header. Pausing is independent from saving settings.
sseHint: Disabled by default until the backend fix is released. Otherwise events are polled every 2 seconds.
